notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Cat.
Activate the Cat by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
